class TestPlanCheckpointing:
    """≡ dl-tuner's gradient-checkpointing decision."""

    def _make_pressure(self, tasks_per_agent, per_task, usable):
        """Helper: just returns the float pressure value."""
        return (tasks_per_agent * per_task) / usable

    def test_low_pressure_no_checkpointing(self):
        # pressure below 0.45 → none
        # e.g. 1 task * 1000 tokens / 100_000 usable = 0.01 → none
        plan = plan_checkpointing(
            tasks_per_agent=1,
            per_task_tokens=1_000,
            usable_context=100_000,
            complexity="medium",
        )
        assert not plan.enabled
        assert plan.strategy == "none"
        assert plan.checkpoint_every is None

        # pressure in [0.45, 0.65) → selective
        # 5 tasks * 10_000 / 100_000 = 0.5 → selective
        plan = plan_checkpointing(
            tasks_per_agent=5,
            per_task_tokens=10_000,
            usable_context=100_000,
            complexity="medium",
        )
        pressure = self._make_pressure(5, 10_000, 100_000)
        assert CHECKPOINT_PRESSURE_THRESHOLD <= pressure < 0.65
        assert plan.enabled
        assert plan.strategy == "selective"
        assert plan.checkpoint_every == 5

        # pressure in [0.65, 0.85) → phase_boundaries
        # 7 tasks * 10_000 / 100_000 = 0.7
        plan = plan_checkpointing(
            tasks_per_agent=7,
            per_task_tokens=10_000,
            usable_context=100_000,
            complexity="high",
        )
        pressure = self._make_pressure(7, 10_000, 100_000)
        assert 0.65 <= pressure < 0.85
        assert plan.enabled
        assert plan.strategy == "phase_boundaries"
        assert plan.checkpoint_every == 3

    def test_extreme_pressure_aggressive(self):
        # pressure >= 0.85 → aggressive

        plan = plan_checkpointing(
            tasks_per_agent=9,
            per_task_tokens=10_000,
